concurrency_and_state: Clan.NEXT_ID (static int) and Clan.clanMessageId (instance int) are incremented without synchronization or AtomicInteger (Clan.java:75, ClanMessage.java:36).

Clan.members, Clan.membersInGame, and Clan.clanMessages use CopyOnWriteArrayList, but addSMTNClan (Clan.java:135), removeMemberOnline (Clan.java:229), and addClanMessage (Clan.java:177) use index-based reverse loops that can throw IndexOutOfBoundsException under concurrent modification.
EventManager uses static mutable booleans (LUNNAR_NEW_YEAR, etc.) and synchronized setEventState() which re-invokes init() on every activation without cleanup/deduplication (EventManager.java:16-96).
AchievementService.confirmAchievement() performs check-then-act (canReward -> reward -> addRuby) without synchronization on player or player.achievement (AchievementService.java:47-60).
cross_module_questions: Does Achievement.canReward/reward in player.achievement use internal synchronization to prevent double-claim on concurrent -76 packets?
Where is Clan.getPlayerOnline(int) called (e.g. ClanService), and do callers expect an online-only Player or handle the detached offline Player returned by NDVSqlFetcher.loadById?
Does EventDAO.loadInternationalWomensDayEvent() properly close JDBC resources and avoid duplicate loading if EventManager.setEventState("INTERNATIONAL_WOMANS_DAY", true) is called at runtime?

db_redis_touchpoints.op: INSERT into clan (id, name, name_2, slogan, img_id, power_point, max_member, clan_point, level, members, tops)
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Connection uses try-with-resources, but PreparedStatement ps is outside try-with-resources; if prepareStatement fails, finally calls ps.close() causing NPE (swallowed).

db_redis_touchpoints.op: UPDATE clan SET slogan, img_id, power_point, max_member, clan_point, level, members, name_2, tops, bdkb_level, bdkb_time WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Connection uses try-with-resources, but PreparedStatement ps is outside try-with-resources (NPE in finally on failure); tops is hardcoded to "[]".
PreparedStatement ps is not in try-with-resources and has no finally block; leaked if executeUpdate throws.
Synchronous DB fetch inside getPlayerOnline() when player is not in membersInGame.
Called during Event.init() and dynamically via EventManager.setEventState().

findings.impact: PreparedStatement leak in deleteDB() on SQL error; NPE in finally block of insert()/update() if getConnection() or prepareStatement() throws, masking or compounding DB errors.
findings.root_cause: PreparedStatement ps is declared outside try-with-resources in insert() and update() with unguarded ps.close() in finally; deleteDB() has no finally or try-with-resources for ps.
findings.title: Unsafe JDBC PreparedStatement lifecycle in Clan DAO methods

findings.impact: Two clans created concurrently can receive identical Clan.id values, causing primary key collisions in DB or corrupted clan lookups; concurrent clan messages can share identical message IDs.
findings.root_cause: Non-atomic post-increment (NEXT_ID++ and clan.clanMessageId++) without synchronization or AtomicInteger.
findings.title: Race condition on Clan.NEXT_ID and ClanMessage.id generation

findings.impact: Concurrent achievement claim packets (-76, sub 1) could pass canReward(select) before reward(select) executes, potentially duplicating Hồng Ngọc (Ruby) rewards.
findings.root_cause: No lock/synchronization around check-then-act (player.achievement.canReward -> reward -> addRuby).
findings.title: Unsynchronized achievement reward claim in AchievementService.confirmAchievement

findings.impact: Callers expecting an in-memory online player lookup incur blocking MySQL I/O and receive an offline detached Player object, risking NPEs or state desync.
findings.root_cause: Clan.getPlayerOnline(int) falls back to NDVSqlFetcher.loadById(playerId) when the player is not in membersInGame.
findings.title: Clan.getPlayerOnline performs synchronous DB load for offline players

findings.impact: IndexOutOfBoundsException if another thread removes an element from membersInGame or clanMessages between size() and get(i); CopyOnWriteArrayList copies the backing array on every add(0, cmg) and remove(i).
findings.root_cause: Index-based reverse iteration over CopyOnWriteArrayList instead of enhanced for-loop or concurrent deque.
findings.title: Unsafe index-based iteration on CopyOnWriteArrayList in Clan

findings.impact: If a player earns Ve Chai, Nap, or Sieu Hang after midnight before renew() is called, ResetTime is updated to today, preventing DapDo and DungLoa daily counters from resetting for the day.
findings.root_cause: addVeChai(), addNap(), and addSieuHang() overwrite this.ResetTime = System.currentTimeMillis() without calling renew() first.
findings.title: TaskDanhHieu progress methods bypass daily reset by updating ResetTime

findings.impact: When no task is active (count == 0, maxCount == 0), getPercentProcess() returns 100% instead of 0%; if maxCount == 0 and count < 0, ArithmeticException / by zero occurs.
findings.root_cause: getPercentProcess() checks count >= maxCount first and divides by maxCount without guarding maxCount <= 0.
findings.title: ClanTask and SideTask getPercentProcess() lacks maxCount <= 0 guard

findings.impact: Toggling an event off and on via setEventState() spawns duplicate event NPCs and bosses on maps; invalid mapId in createNpc() causes NPE.
findings.root_cause: EventManager.setEventState() calls new <Event>().init() on every activation without tracking initialized state or cleaning up previous NPCs/bosses; Event.createNpc() does not null-check MapService.getMapById(mapId).
findings.title: EventManager.setEventState duplicates NPCs and bosses on re-activation

findings.impact: If Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE.size() exceeds 127, writeByte overflows to a negative value on the client; in Clan.sendMessageClan, exceptions before cleanup() leak the Message.
findings.root_cause: Achievement count written as signed byte; Clan.sendMessageClan lacks finally block for msg.cleanup() and silently swallows exceptions.
findings.title: Protocol byte size truncation in AchievementService and missing finally cleanup in Clan.sendMessageClan

findings.impact: Bloated class file and constant pool; difficult to maintain task IDs.
findings.root_cause: Thousands of enumerated TASK_X_Y constants instead of a helper method computing (taskId << 11) + (index << 1).
findings.title: ConstTask contains thousands of repetitive hardcoded task constants

module_summary: Read ConstTask (lines 2801-6359), ConstTournament, SocketType, the event subsystem (Event, IEvent, EventManager, and 8 event_list classes), clan models (Clan, ClanMember, ClanMessage), task models (ClanTask, SideTask, TaskMain, SubTaskMain, TaskPlayer, TaskDanhHieu), and AchievementService. Found P1 JDBC PreparedStatement lifecycle bugs, non-atomic ID generation races, unsynchronized achievement reward claiming, blocking DB fallback in Clan.getPlayerOnline, and P2 logic/concurrency issues in CopyOnWriteArrayList iteration, TaskDanhHieu daily resets, task percent calculation, and EventManager re-activation.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Clan message broadcast: type(byte), id(int), playerId(int), playerName(UTF), role(byte), time(int), plus type-0 text/color or type-1 donate counts.
Open Achievement UI: sub(byte=0), count(byte), then per template info1(UTF), info2(UTF), money(short), isFinish(boolean), isRecieve(boolean).
